newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's MVM electricity not for sale in 1997 - APV.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's MVM electricity not for sale in 1997 - APV.

text.p: Hungary's national electricity company Magyar Villamos Muvek RT will not be sold this year, a privatisation agency APV Rt official said on Thursday.
Arpad Kovacs, director of APV's board, was quoted by Hungarian news agency MTI-Econews as saying that MVM's privatisation income is not in APV's 1997 plan.
Kovacs said MVM's privatisation will probably not happen this year as questions like the conversion of earlier assets and long-distance electricity transfer remained unsolved.

He said MVM's duties under the Nuclear Act passed last autumn remain to be defined while the issue of whether to hive off coal-fired plants and the country's only nuclear plant before selling MVM is also yet to be decided.
Kovacs also said that the privatisation of other companies, such as chemicals company Nitrokemia Rt, could also be postponed until next year.
